commands: git fetch origin mvp/environment-controller && git reset --hard origin/mvp/environment-controller && git clean -fd && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "b0b63d8821687f38a7780d65f0b6d6110729fdfe" && test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-110

set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

h = Path('src/climate/native/NativeI2cBus.h')
s = h.read_text()
old = '  esp_err_t addDevice(std::uint8_t address, std::uint32_t clock_hz,\n                      i2c_master_dev_handle_t& device) noexcept;'
new = old + '\n  esp_err_t probe(std::uint8_t address, int timeout_ms = 100) noexcept;'
assert old in s and 'esp_err_t probe(' not in s
h.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

cpp = Path('src/climate/native/NativeI2cBus.cpp')
s = cpp.read_text()
assert 'NativeI2cBus::probe(' not in s
marker = '\n} // namespace growbox::app::climate_io::native\n'
method = '\nesp_err_t NativeI2cBus::probe(std::uint8_t address, int timeout_ms) noexcept {\n  if (bus_ == nullptr) {\n    return ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE;\n  }\n  return i2c_master_probe(bus_, address, timeout_ms);\n}\n'
assert marker in s
cpp.write_text(s.replace(marker, method + marker))

scd = Path('src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.cpp')
s = scd.read_text()
assert '#include <esp_log.h>' not in s
s = s.replace('#include <driver/i2c_master.h>', '#include <driver/i2c_master.h>\n#include <esp_log.h>')
s = s.replace('constexpr std::uint8_t kScd41Address = 0x62U;', 'constexpr char kScd41Tag[] = "scd41";\nconstexpr std::uint8_t kScd41Address = 0x62U;')
old = '  const int16_t error = scd4x_start_periodic_measurement();\n  available_ = error == 0;'
new = '  const int16_t error = scd4x_start_periodic_measurement();\n  if (error != 0) {\n    ESP_LOGW(kScd41Tag, "start_periodic_measurement failed: %d", static_cast<int>(error));\n  }\n  available_ = error == 0;'
assert old in s
scd.write_text(s.replace(old, new))

rt = Path('src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp')
s = rt.read_text()
assert '#include <esp_err.h>' not in s
s = s.replace('#include <esp_log.h>', '#include <esp_err.h>\n#include <esp_log.h>')
old = '  native::NativeI2cBus i2c(GROWBOX_I2C_SDA_GPIO, GROWBOX_I2C_SCL_GPIO);\n  const bool i2c_ready = i2c.begin() == ESP_OK;\n\n  native::Scd41InsideSource inside;'
new = '  native::NativeI2cBus i2c(GROWBOX_I2C_SDA_GPIO, GROWBOX_I2C_SCL_GPIO);\n  const bool i2c_ready = i2c.begin() == ESP_OK;\n  const esp_err_t scd41_probe = i2c_ready ? i2c.probe(0x62U) : ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE;\n  const esp_err_t rtc_probe = i2c_ready ? i2c.probe(0x68U) : ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE;\n  ESP_LOGI(kTag, "I2C probe: scd41_0x62=%s ds3231_0x68=%s", esp_err_to_name(scd41_probe),\n           esp_err_to_name(rtc_probe));\n\n  native::Scd41InsideSource inside;'
assert old in s
rt.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files src/climate/native/NativeI2cBus.h src/climate/native/NativeI2cBus.cpp src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.cpp src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp && git diff --check && grep -q 'NativeI2cBus::probe' src/climate/native/NativeI2cBus.cpp && grep -q 'I2C probe:' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh clean && bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build

PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-110 bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash && .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import serial
import time

port = '/dev/cu.usbserial-110'
deadline = time.monotonic() + 90.0
print(f'SERIAL_CAPTURE_BEGIN port={port} seconds=90', flush=True)
with serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=1.0) as ser:
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        raw = ser.readline()
        if raw:
            line = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').rstrip()
            if 'climate_stage27' in line or 'scd41' in line or 'NimBLE' in line:
                print(line, flush=True)
print('SERIAL_CAPTURE_END', flush=True)
PY

git add src/climate/native/NativeI2cBus.h src/climate/native/NativeI2cBus.cpp src/climate/native/Scd41InsideSource.cpp src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp && git diff --cached --check && git commit -m 'Add Stage27C I2C probe diagnostics' && git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller && git status --short && git rev-parse HEAD
